analyzed-privileges-count.description: Number of privileges evaluated by this analysis.

condition.description: One complete policy condition serialized as a JSON name/value or name/values object per attribute, retaining grouping and types.

potential-attacks-count.description: Number of privilege-to-attack mappings reported by the analyzer; this is not a count of observed attacks.

privilege.description: One granted action or privilege per attribute.

unused-privileges-count.description: Number of evaluated privileges unused within the source analysis timeframe.

unused-services-count.description: Number of services or resource types not used within the source analysis timeframe.

description: One identity-centric permission analysis result with granted actions and counts of unused permissions, unused services and potential attack mappings. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/permission_analysis_result.
name: permission-analysis
